## Package encoding/json

Go memiliki dukungan JSON built-in yang sangat baik melalui package `encoding/json`.

## Marshal: Go → JSON

`json.Marshal()` mengubah struct Go menjadi JSON:

```go
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

type Person struct {
	Name    string `json:"name"`
	Age     int    `json:"age"`
	Email   string `json:"email,omitempty"` // omit jika kosong
	password string // unexported — diabaikan oleh JSON
}

func main() {
	p := Person{Name: "Alice", Age: 30, Email: "alice@example.com"}

	data, err := json.Marshal(p)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("Error:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(string(data))
	// {"name":"Alice","age":30,"email":"alice@example.com"}

	// Pretty print
	pretty, _ := json.MarshalIndent(p, "", "  ")
	fmt.Println(string(pretty))
}
```

## Unmarshal: JSON → Go

`json.Unmarshal()` mengurai JSON ke struct Go:

```go
jsonStr := `{"name":"Bob","age":25,"email":"bob@example.com"}`

var p Person
if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(jsonStr), &p); err != nil {
	fmt.Println("Error:", err)
	return
}
fmt.Printf("%+v\n", p) // {Name:Bob Age:25 Email:bob@example.com password:}
```

## Struct Tags JSON

```go
type Product struct {
	ID       int    `json:"id"`            // rename field
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Price    float64 `json:"price"`
	InStock  bool   `json:"in_stock"`
	Internal string `json:"-"`             // selalu diabaikan
	Notes    string `json:"notes,omitempty"` // diabaikan jika zero value
}
```

## Streaming JSON dengan Encoder/Decoder

Untuk file besar atau HTTP, gunakan `json.NewEncoder`/`json.NewDecoder`:

```go
// Encode ke file
file, _ := os.Create("data.json")
defer file.Close()
encoder := json.NewEncoder(file)
encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
encoder.Encode(p) // tidak butuh json.Marshal

// Decode dari HTTP response
resp, _ := http.Get("https://api.example.com/user")
defer resp.Body.Close()
var user User
json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&user)
```
content_en:
## The encoding/json Package

Go has excellent built-in JSON support through the `encoding/json` package.

## Marshal: Go → JSON

`json.Marshal()` converts a Go struct to JSON:

```go
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

type Person struct {
	Name    string `json:"name"`
	Age     int    `json:"age"`
	Email   string `json:"email,omitempty"` // omit if empty
	password string // unexported — ignored by JSON
}

func main() {
	p := Person{Name: "Alice", Age: 30, Email: "alice@example.com"}

	data, err := json.Marshal(p)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("Error:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(string(data))
	// {"name":"Alice","age":30,"email":"alice@example.com"}

	// Pretty print
	pretty, _ := json.MarshalIndent(p, "", "  ")
	fmt.Println(string(pretty))
}
```

## Unmarshal: JSON → Go

`json.Unmarshal()` parses JSON into a Go struct:

```go
jsonStr := `{"name":"Bob","age":25,"email":"bob@example.com"}`

var p Person
if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(jsonStr), &p); err != nil {
	fmt.Println("Error:", err)
	return
}
fmt.Printf("%+v\n", p) // {Name:Bob Age:25 Email:bob@example.com password:}
```

## JSON Struct Tags

```go
type Product struct {
	ID       int     `json:"id"`              // rename field
	Name     string  `json:"name"`
	Price    float64 `json:"price"`
	InStock  bool    `json:"in_stock"`
	Internal string  `json:"-"`              // always ignored
	Notes    string  `json:"notes,omitempty"` // ignored if zero value
}
```

## Streaming JSON with Encoder/Decoder

For large files or HTTP, use `json.NewEncoder`/`json.NewDecoder`:

```go
// Encode to file
file, _ := os.Create("data.json")
defer file.Close()
encoder := json.NewEncoder(file)
encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
encoder.Encode(p) // no need for json.Marshal

// Decode from HTTP response
resp, _ := http.Get("https://api.example.com/user")
defer resp.Body.Close()
var user User
json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&user)
```

quiz.question_id: Fungsi mana yang mengubah struct Go menjadi JSON `[]byte`?
quiz.question_en: Which function converts a Go struct into JSON `[]byte`?
options_en: `json.Marshal`
`json.NewEncoder`
`json.Unmarshal`
`json.NewDecoder`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa field `password` pada struct `Person` tidak muncul dalam output JSON pada contoh?
quiz.question_en: Why does the `password` field on the `Person` struct not appear in the JSON output in the example?
options_id: Karena field itu unexported sehingga diabaikan oleh `encoding/json`
Karena harus diberi tag `json:"password"` agar bisa dienkripsi
options_en: Because the field is unexported, so `encoding/json` ignores it
Because string fields are always hidden
Because it needs a `json:"password"` tag to be encrypted
Because `Marshal` only writes integer fields

quiz.question_en: What is the effect of the `json:"email,omitempty"` tag in the `Person` example?
options_id: Field dihilangkan jika nilainya zero value
options_en: The field is omitted if its value is the zero value
The field is always written with the name `omitempty`
The field becomes private during decode
The field only applies to `MarshalIndent`

quiz.question_en: What does the `json:"-"` tag mean on the `Product` struct?
options_id: Field otomatis memakai nama asli struct field
options_en: The field is always ignored by JSON
The field is only used during decoding
The field automatically uses the original struct field name
The field only appears in pretty-printed output

options_id: Saat ingin output JSON yang lebih mudah dibaca manusia
Saat ingin decode dari HTTP response
Saat field unexported harus ikut muncul
Saat output harus selalu lebih kecil ukurannya
options_en: When you want JSON output that is easier for humans to read
When you want to decode from an HTTP response
When unexported fields must also appear
When the output must always be smaller

quiz.question_en: Why is `json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&user)` a good fit for an HTTP response?
options_id: Karena bisa decode langsung dari `io.Reader` tanpa membaca seluruh body ke memori lebih dulu
Karena HTTP response tidak bisa dipakai dengan `Unmarshal`
options_en: Because it can decode directly from an `io.Reader` without first loading the whole body into memory
Because `Decode` cannot fail
Because an HTTP response can never be used with `Unmarshal`
Because `Decoder` automatically exports private fields

quiz.question_id: Apa keuntungan utama `json.NewEncoder(file).Encode(p)` pada contoh file besar?
quiz.question_en: What is the main advantage of `json.NewEncoder(file).Encode(p)` in the large-file example?
options_id: Bisa menulis langsung ke writer seperti file tanpa perlu menyimpan hasil `Marshal` terpisah
options_en: It can write directly to a writer such as a file without storing a separate `Marshal` result first
It always produces JSON without a newline
It removes the need for `defer file.Close()`
It makes every field `omitempty`

quiz.question_id: Pada `json.Unmarshal([]byte(jsonStr), &p)`, mengapa argumen kedua harus `&p` dan bukan `p`?
quiz.question_en: In `json.Unmarshal([]byte(jsonStr), &p)`, why must the second argument be `&p` instead of `p`?
options_id: Agar decoder bisa menulis hasil parse ke variabel target
Agar field dengan tag `omitempty` ikut terisi
options_en: So the decoder can write the parsed result into the target variable
So the struct becomes exported
So the JSON becomes pretty-printed
So fields with `omitempty` will also be filled

quiz.question_id: Tag mana yang mengganti nama field JSON menjadi `in_stock`?
quiz.question_en: Which tag renames a JSON field to `in_stock`?
options_en: `` `json:"in_stock"` ``
`` `json:"omitempty"` ``
`` `json:"stock,in"` ``

quiz.question_id: Tradeoff desain apa yang terlihat dari contoh `encoding/json` pada lesson?
quiz.question_en: What design tradeoff is illustrated by the `encoding/json` examples in the lesson?
options_id: Exported fields dan explicit tags membentuk shape JSON publik, sementara field unexported atau ignored tetap internal
Semua field struct otomatis harus muncul dalam JSON
Struct tags hanya dipakai untuk validasi runtime
Streaming encoder dan decoder hanya berguna untuk data kecil
options_en: Exported fields and explicit tags define the public JSON shape, while unexported or ignored fields stay internal
Every struct field must automatically appear in JSON
Struct tags are only used for runtime validation
Streaming encoders and decoders are only useful for small data
